title: Chapter 1183
text:
As soon as Han Xiao's remote projection arrived at the venue, he could feel many surprised and admiring gazes looking at him from all directions.

"Black Star!"

Hearing someone call him, Han Xiao turned around and saw Kasuyi and the others coming over. They were all familiar with the peak Beyond Grade As.

"Why did you call me?"

"Hehe, not bad." Kant looked at him and laughed.

"You should say that to the Mecha Empire. He needs comfort right now." Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

"Hahaha, I haven't seen you in a while, and you've become worse." Everyone laughed.

In the circle, Han Xiao did not have a certain sense of distance like the Mecha Empire. He was more popular, and most people were willing to be friends with him.

Kasuyi smiled helplessly and asked, "Black Star, I heard that you captured the troops of the Mecha Empire. Those two Beyond Grade As, did you find out where they came from?"

Han Xiao shook his head and casually revealed Manison's background. He roughly explained the Felon technology and emphasized, "Their brains were messed up by Manison. They can't remember anything from their past."

"Sigh, the two people you captured should be Suller and Cain. I used to have a good relationship with Cain, but that was a long time ago …" Milizaus sighed.

For a rare and talented Big Treasure like him, he hated experiments on physical modification the most. Before he became a Beyond Grade A, there would occasionally be dragon cubs who went missing and were captured by Interstellar Hunters to be sold for money. Most of the time, they were sold to some research institutions to study their racial characteristics, so he was very sensitive to this.

Everyone introduced the lives of Suller and Cain. The former was the Second Treasure, and the latter was the Fourth Treasure. They used to be very powerful Beyond Grade As, but because of different reasons, they provoked the Mecha Empire and eventually disappeared. Who would have thought that when they met again, their old friends had already become puppets? Many people present sighed.

"Speaking of which, not long ago, you weren't the Mecha Empire's … uh, at most, you were on par with him. Why did the Mecha Empire use their trump card this time and let you take advantage of it? Do you have some tricks?" Sun Hunter asked.

"Nothing, I was just lucky."

Han Xiao subconsciously said humbly, but as soon as he said that, he noticed that everyone's gaze became strange.

Everyone looked at Secret Master and gestured with their chins, indicating that it was his turn to perform.

However, Secret Master was indifferent, as if he did not hear Han Xiao.

Sierron could not help but whisper, "Why didn't you refute him like before? Aren't you a professional? "

Secret Master glanced at him. "I'll give him face."

"I see …"

Sierron nodded, but then he suddenly realized something.

"Wait, then why didn't you give me face just now?"

"There's no need."

Veins popped out on Sierron's forehead.

We're all peak Beyond Grade As, and you're so blatantly treating us differently!

"So, you're afraid of offending Black Star, but you're not afraid of offending me, right?"

"Yeah." Secret Master was confused. "Where did you get the confidence to ask this question?"

He was confused. Black Star, that unlucky guy, never mind that his luck can't be shaved, but you're so lucky, don't you know it?

Sierron was speechless. He pointed at Secret Master and could not say anything.

You … you're too much. Can't you pretend to coax me?

The group chatted for a while, and it was time for the meeting to begin. Everyone entered the venue and took their seats.

At this time, Manison's remote projection arrived just in time. After arriving, he did not look at anyone, ignored everyone's weird gazes, and walked straight into the venue.

He had arrived on time because he did not want to meet Han Xiao in advance. He did not even need to think to know how Black Star would show off in front of him.

When he passed by Han Xiao's seat, Manison purposely ignored him. He thought that Han Xiao would take the opportunity to mock him, but Black Star seemed to have changed his personality and completely ignored him.

This made Manison, who was mentally prepared, feel like he had missed. He was not used to it and even had the urge to initiate a conversation.

Noticing Manison's gaze, Han Xiao did not even look at him. You think I'm mocking you, but I'm deliberately ignoring you. This is still a form of mockery.

Suppressing the urge to talk, Manison coughed and said with a deep voice, "I hereby announce the start of this meeting. Everyone …"

Before he finished, Han Xiao stood up and slowly said, "I have something to inform everyone."

Everyone's gazes turned to look at him.

Han Xiao leaned forward, pressed his hands on the table, and said, "Some of you might not know about my experience a while ago, so I'll explain it here. I have a personal grudge with the Modo Civilization, and it originated from the Kunde Race incident during the second exploration phase. Modo induced the native civilization to ambush the Red Empire, causing the flames of war. My Black Star Corps also participated in the battle and lost many of my men. Later, the Kunde Race submitted to me and accepted my protection. Thus, I also took on the mission of finding the culprit.

Originally, this war could have been completely avoided, but Modo's scheme made us lose the chance to coexist peacefully. My grudge with Modo is partly because of the personal grudge of the losses of my troops and partly because of morality.

Modo and I are enemies, and it's understandable that we hurt each other. I also accept the casualties that Modo caused to my troops on the frontlines, but Modo's scheme behind the scenes … It's fine if it's just a scheme. After all, it's also a feasible method. However, he shouldn't have involved this matter with another unrelated Beyond Grade A. "

As he said that, Han Xiao pointed at Ames. Seeing that everyone was listening quietly, he said, "The Dragon Queen had nothing to do with this.

"The Dragon Emperor originally had nothing to do with this, but Modo wanted to threaten me by kidnapping her adoptive father. Some of the people present even helped Modo …"

As he said that, Han Xiao glanced at Manison. Without waiting for Manison to speak, he immediately continued.

"This kind of behavior is very despicable, and it's completely ignoring everyone else. Therefore, the Dragon Emperor decided to intervene in the war and teach Modo a lesson. I've also decided to go personally …"

Han Xiao paused, looked around, and said with a deep voice, "I've finished speaking.

"I'm done. Who agrees? Who objects? "

The whole place fell silent. Everyone looked at each other with strange expressions.

This was because before the Flickering War, the agreement that everyone had made in this room was that the Beyond Grade As would stay out of it. Their troops would be able to get some benefits, or they would be able to take revenge in some special cases. However, it was a mutual agreement that they would not personally participate in the war. Black Star's request was obviously going to be the first to break this agreement.

Manison narrowed his eyes and said, "I don't think that's possible. You're the vice president. If you take the lead to violate the agreement, won't the principle of our united front lose its binding force? Today, you found a reason to do it personally, and we agreed. Tomorrow, I'll also find a reason to do it personally, and you'll also agree, right? As long as you find a reason, anyone can do whatever they want. Then, is there still a need for the association to exist? "

"Old people really don't know how to be flexible." Han Xiao clicked his tongue. "How long has it been since our association was established, and there are already signs of the system becoming rigid? This is very much in line with your style as a leader. "

Manison's eyelids twitched, but he secretly heaved a sigh of relief.

It was still the familiar formula, still the familiar feeling. Black Star was indeed still that Black Star, an old eunuch.

Han Xiao ignored him, looked around, and said, "My suggestion is not only because of personal grudges but also because of the association's prestige and the principle of the united front."

"What do you mean?" Kant on the side consciously played the role of a supporting actor.

"What the Mecha Empire said does make some sense, but for the specific problem and the specific analysis, we have to understand the nature of this matter first. In order to deal with me, Modo casually schemed against an unrelated Beyond Grade A, and this Beyond Grade A is also a member of the association … What kind of behavior is this? Let me assume, hmm, let's use the Limitless Financial Group as an example. For example, I want to embezzle the assets of the Limitless Financial Group, and I know that Manison is a major shareholder, so I kidnap Manison, torture him, and ask Sorokin to sign some unequal agreements. What would your reaction be? "

Sorokin was suddenly cued and was a little confused.

You guys can talk about your own things. Why did you call me?

If that's really the case, I'll probably be overjoyed. I'll have one less dog to share my money with …

"Ahem, I'll be very angry."

Han Xiao then looked at Manison and said, "If you get out … and I'm saying if. After all, everyone knows that if you fall into my hands, there's no way you can escape … Anyway, you'll definitely take revenge afterward, right?"

"… That's right." Manison's mouth twitched imperceptibly.

"See, this is human nature. It's very similar to the situation I encountered." Han Xiao clapped his hands and said with a deep voice, "But why did the association do the opposite and stop this kind of behavior? Wasn't our original intention of establishing the association to give the Beyond Grade As a better future and a higher status? Why did we put shackles on ourselves instead? "

As he said that, Han Xiao walked behind Manison, put his hands on his shoulders, and said loudly, "The principle of the principle of a united front is to fight.

When a member is in trouble, everyone will come to help. The Modo Civilization attacked an unrelated Beyond Grade A first, breaking the rules first. If we don't punish them, what will others think? Will they feel that the association is restricting the revenge of the Beyond Grade As, so they are more confident and bold to attack a Beyond Grade A? What is this!

"If we want a higher status, other than establishing order for ourselves to make the galactic society feel safe, we also have to make the outsiders respect the Beyond Grade As. This is the way to control the right to speak, not the wrong way to put the cart before the horse.

"Therefore, although the purpose of the association is to mediate, we have to immediately punish the Modo Civilization for their provocative behavior. Otherwise, we'll lose the prestige of the entire Beyond Grade A class. This is the true meaning of our united front! "The slogan of 'advance and retreat together' is not only for us to 'retreat' but also for us to 'advance' together!

"We're a group now. If the others don't want to suffer like the Dragon Emperor this time, not only should they agree to this action, but they should also provide help to deal with Modo together. "Don't forget how the Tragedy of the Pinnacles came about. Unity is very important. The association should make a serious statement to Modo and strike back. Only then will the entire universe know that the Beyond Grade A class is no longer the same. We're united."

Although they felt that something was not right, many people could not deny that Black Star's words had struck a chord in their hearts. It did sound very reasonable.

"Of course, our association has to have freedom. I won't force anyone to deal with Modo together, but I'll definitely help Ames myself because I always remember how I got rich. Now, let me ask you the question again … "

Han Xiao stared at the crowd and enunciated each word clearly.

"Who agrees? Who opposes? "

After two seconds of silence, Beyoni raised his hand and broke the silence.

"I agree!"

"Me too." Kohler was not to be outdone.

With someone taking the lead, the people of the Red Empire, other than Heber, all voted. Some of the neutral Beyond Grade As in the association who sided with Black Star also expressed their agreement, and the crowd responded!

Ames rested her chin on her hand as she watched this scene. Her curved eyes were full of smiles. She loved to see Han Xiao talking so calmly in front of everyone.

The people of the Mecha Empire looked at Manison. Seeing that Manison was silent, they did not object. Seeing this, Kasuyi and the other directors also voted.

"Black Star is right. We can't do anything about the personal grudge between him and the Modo Civilization. However, we have to follow the rules of war even when we're fighting. We can't use methods that are too sinister without limits. Modo has already crossed the line by plotting against the family of another Beyond Grade A who is not involved in this matter," the old dragon said.

"That's right, that's right. I especially agree with what Black Star said about the true meaning of a united front. If the Mecha Empire kidnaps me one day, you guys have to come and save me," Sun Hunter joked.

Manison glanced at him coldly. "Don't worry, you're too young. I'm not interested."

At this time, a neutral Beyond Grade A who had been lurking suddenly said, "Black Star said that he wants to deal with Modo, but the Mecha Empire is also an accomplice. Why don't you take revenge on him? I think you should treat everyone equally."

Hearing this, the room fell silent again. Many people's expressions became strange.

He's definitely fanning the flames! Good kid, you've got guts!

Han Xiao glanced at him and was amused.

Yo, I remember that this guy was one of the 'mercenaries' of the Supercluster Alliance in my previous life. Maybe he's actually a direct descendant of a certain Supercluster civilization, just like Traveler.

Trying to shift the hatred and confuse everyone here? Could this guy be a secret direct descendant of Modo?

This thought flashed through his mind. Seeing that everyone was looking at him, Han Xiao waved his hands magnanimously and sighed on purpose.

"One of the purposes of our association is to mediate conflicts between Beyond Grade As. Although Manison is heartless, I can't be unjust. I'll just take it as me taking a loss and won't pursue it."

As soon as he said that, Manison's body trembled. His mentality that he had finally calmed down in the past few days almost exploded again.

Can you even speak human language?

You took away the Soul Swapper and stole two of my Felons. You call that a loss?

Then, I want to take a loss like that too, and I want to take it every day!

Seeing Manison's twitching face, many people hurriedly raised their hands to stroke their beards to hide the crazy smile on their faces.

Manison closed his eyes, took a few seconds to suppress his anger, and said with an expressionless face, "Black Star, even if you took my sample, you won't be able to learn my technology."

He had this confidence. Be it the Felon technology or the Indestructible Mechanical Troops technology, he had mixed his original methods in them. This was the essence he had mastered after secretly innovating the Virtual Technology.

Without the prior knowledge of the Virtual Technology innovation, he was sure that even if Black Star had some results, he would at most obtain something that was neither right nor wrong. It would be impossible for him to restore all the details of the two technologies.

"Don't worry, I won't stop you from comforting yourself." Han Xiao chuckled.

"Humph, stubborn. If I'm not wrong, your research has reached a bottleneck since the beginning, right?"

Han Xiao hesitated for a moment and did not reply.

Seeing this, Manison's lips curled up slightly. Feeling that he had guessed correctly, his mood finally improved a little. He slowly said, "I guessed correctly, so you don't dare to answer?"

Han Xiao shook his head and said hesitantly, "I think you have a long life ahead of you.

"I just feel that you're old and don't have many years left to live. I'm afraid that if I tell you the truth, you'll have a heart attack and die on the spot. If that's the case, the credit for killing you won't be given to me. Wouldn't that be a waste?"

"… F * ck off!"
